project: Reliable LLM Agents for Routing and Triage

labels.name: Concept Explanation
labels.definition: Requests for clarifying theoretical computer science concepts, algorithms, or language syntax without involving specific code troubleshooting.

labels.name: Debugging & Code Troubleshooting
labels.definition: Requests for identifying, explaining, or fixing errors within a specific piece of student-provided code or error log.

labels.name: Assignment & Grading Policy
labels.definition: Questions regarding assignment requirements, grading rubrics, late submission policies, or formatting guidelines.

labels.name: Exam & Assessment Prep
labels.definition: Inquiries about exam formats, permitted materials, study guides, or requests for practice questions.

labels.name: Course Logistics & Environment Setup
labels.definition: Questions about IDE/software installation, accessing course platforms, lecture schedules, or office hour timings.

labels.name: Instructor/TA Escalation
labels.definition: Complex, sensitive, or highly specific queries (e.g., grade disputes, personal accommodations, suspected plagiarism) that require direct human faculty intervention.

labels.name: Clarification Needed
labels.definition: The request is too vague or underspecified to be accurately routed.

labels.name: Appointments & Care Access
labels.definition: Requests to schedule, cancel, reschedule, or inquire about medical appointments or how to receive care

labels.name: Billing & Insurance
labels.definition: Questions about insurance coverage, accepted plans, payments, copays, cost estimates, or medical bills.

labels.name: Patient Administrative Support
labels.definition: Non-clinical administrative requests such as medical records, prescription logistics, visitor policies, or other operational inquiries that require staff assistance.

labels.name: Provider & Location Search
labels.definition: Ambiguous, complex, or privacy-sensitive administrative requests (e.g., medical records release) that require review by a human receptionist or patient advocate.

labels.name: Emergency Services
labels.definition: Requests to find a doctor, specialist, clinic, hospital location, or contact information for a facility.

labels.name: Clarification Needed
labels.definition: Queries that are too vague, incomplete, or ambiguous to confidently route to a specific category.
